mapper.select: select * from ( select reservation_no, reservation_name, reservation_phone, reservation_type, reservation_time, reservation_status, reservation_ctime from reservation order by reservation_ctime desc ) where rownum <= 5

select * from ( select reservation_no, reservation_name, reservation_phone, reservation_type, reservation_time, reservation_status, reservation_ctime from reservation where reservation_time >= trunc(sysdate) and reservation_time < trunc(sysdate) + 1 and reservation_status != '9' order by reservation_time asc ) where rownum <= 5
select count(*) from reservation where reservation_time >= trunc(sysdate) and reservation_time < trunc(sysdate) + 1 and reservation_status != '9'

select * from consult_customer
or instr(student_name, #{search}) > 0 or instr(student_phone, #{search}) > 0 or instr(parent_name, #{search}) > 0 or instr(parent_phone, #{search}) > 0
order by customer_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into consult_customer ( customer_no, student_name, student_phone, student_email, student_address, student_school, student_grade, student_gender, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, customer_memo ) values ( #{customerNo}, #{studentName}, #{studentPhone}, #{studentEmail}, #{studentAddress}, #{studentSchool}, #{studentGrade}, #{studentGender}, #{parentName}, #{parentPhone}, #{parentEmail}, #{customerMemo} )
mapper.select: select c.*, e.employee_type, a.account_name from consult c inner join employee e on e.employee_no = c.consult_employee_no inner join account a on a.account_no = e.account_no where c.customer_no = #{customerNo} order by c.consult_ctime desc
mapper.insert: insert into consult ( consult_no, customer_no, consult_employee_no, consult_title, consult_content ) values ( #{consultNo}, #{customerNo}, #{consultEmployeeNo}, #{consultTitle}, #{consultContent} )
